rungs.name: Offline toolchain preflight
validate: $required = @('git', 'make', 'gcc'); $missing = $required | Where-Object { -not (Get-Command $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }; if ($missing) { throw "Missing required tools: $($missing -join ', ')" }; if (-not (Test-Path 'aelion/Makefile')) { throw 'Missing aelion/Makefile.' }

rungs.name: Clean local build
validate: Set-Location aelion; make clean; make all; make check
